definitions.compression: population standard deviation of projected and actual team points on identical graded games; reporting only
definitions.flags: abs(mean error) > 2 game-cluster standard errors; at least two games and qualified input; exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted
definitions.reference: 2016–2025 adaptive OOF; coverage excludes 2016 (no prior residuals)

definitions.coverage: Inclusive endpoints, hits and observation counts; team denominator has two observations per game
definitions.negative_support: Measured without truncation; negative team/total score mass is an unresolved legacy limitation
definitions.pit: Mid-PIT: P(X<actual)+0.5 P(X=actual); discrete mid-PIT need not be uniform
definitions.points: Original legacy ridge centers, not relabeled as distribution means
definitions.population: All-fit operational aggregate plus exact fit/calibration strata; AS_ISSUED and RETROSPECTIVE separate
definitions.probability: P(home win) plus half P(tie); Brier uses fractional tie outcome 0.5
definitions.team_intervals: Reconstructed derivative of original calibration; not originally stored team bands

uncertainty.method: Percentile paired-game bootstrap, both teams together
uncertainty.review_requested: Tier 2: game resampling ignores cross-game dependence; alternative week blocks is not qualified by two weeks. Descriptive only, no decision or gate.
